notes: Stories defined for backend clinical trials search including schema, logic, API integration, testing, and facade orchestration.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define input/output schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status filter, and structured response fields (trial_id, title, locations, distance, travel_time). Ensure alignment with existing Pydantic models.

stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Search Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results, and normalize trial data including locations and eligibility metadata.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes (or equivalent) to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site. Attach computed metrics to trial results.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search through EvaluateCare facade and tool router, enabling conversational access and proper tool invocation with validated inputs.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating API query behavior, recruiting filter enforcement, distance calculations, and facade/tool routing integration.
